title: Classes
emptyDescription: Create a class, then add students by username.
emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Classes created by teachers will appear here.
searchEmptyDescription: Try a different name or description.
studentsLoadFailed: Failed to load the student roster
selectHintDescription: Choose a class on the left to review its roster.
noStudentsDescription: Add students by their account username.
accessDeniedDescription: Student accounts cannot access class management.

editor.description: Students are added by username and can belong to one class at a time.
editor.name: Class name
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional, e.g. Introduction to Computer Science cohort
editor.invalid: Check the class name and description length.

addStudentDialog.title: Add student
addStudentDialog.description: Enter the student account username. A student can belong to only one class.

studentAccounts.createDescription: The student is added to this class. A random initial password is required to be changed at first sign-in. Existing accounts stay unchanged.
studentAccounts.importDescription: UTF-8 CSV only, up to 1 MB and 200 students per import. New accounts join this class; existing accounts are skipped.
studentAccounts.fileTooLarge: Roster files must be 1 MB or smaller.
studentAccounts.passwordNote: New accounts' initial passwords are displayed and downloadable once. Students must change their password at first sign-in. Store the downloaded CSV securely.
studentAccounts.credentialsDescription: Download and store this list securely. Passwords disappear when this dialog closes. Students must change their password at first sign-in.
studentAccounts.noNewCredentials: No new accounts were created, so there are no initial passwords to download.

deleteDialog.title: Delete class
deleteDialog.description: Delete "{name}"? Its students become unassigned. This cannot be undone.

toast.accountCreated: Student account created and added to class

activities.title: Class quizzes
activities.description: Choose preview questions from course lessons. Students can answer after you publish.
activities.emptyDescription: Choose course lessons to create a preview quiz, then publish it for your students.

createDialog.title: Choose course preview questions
createDialog.description: Each lesson supplies one preview question. Select up to 10, save a draft, then publish it to your class.
createDialog.question: Question {index}
createDialog.search: Search lesson number, title or chapter
createDialog.loadFailed: Failed to load course preview questions
createDialog.invalid: Enter a title and select 1 to 10 lessons.

reportDialog.title: Quiz statistics
reportDialog.description: Check completion first, then discuss the option distribution; draw a student to explain their reasoning.
reportDialog.randomHint: Students who have not submitted are picked first, so you can call on them in class.

student.title: Class activities
student.subtitle: Only quizzes your teacher has published appear here. Submissions are final and correct answers stay hidden.
student.noClassroom: You have not joined a class yet
student.noClassroomDescription: Ask your teacher to add your account to the class, then come back.
student.emptyDescription: Pre-class previews and in-class checks appear here once your teacher publishes them.
student.locked: Answers cannot be changed after submission
student.closedNote: This quiz is closed and no longer accepts answers.
student.teacherHintTitle: Manage class activities from the class page
student.teacherHint: Open Classes → Class activities to select course preview questions, publish quizzes and view statistics. Students answer here.
